title: SentenceBoundaryConfig
description: Schema contract for the SentenceBoundaryConfig frozen dataclass defining sentence boundary detection parameters.

terminators.description: Characters recognized as sentence terminators (e.g. '.!?:'). Must be a non-empty Unicode string.

punctuation_marks.description: Characters treated as punctuation marks in sentence boundary analysis. Must be a non-empty Unicode string.

abbrev_str.description: Whitespace-separated abbreviation list (e.g. 'Dr. Mr. Prof.') used to suppress sentence splits on abbreviation boundaries.

words_before.description: Number of context words included before the target sentence boundary. Non-negative integer.

words_after.description: Number of context words included after the target sentence boundary. Non-negative integer.

max_words.description: Maximum total context words allowed per boundary window (0 means unlimited). Non-negative integer.
